epg.title: Digging For Truffles

epg.title: Rock'n Troll

epg.title: Super Pet Sweet Up Surprise

epg.title: The Great Desert Dash
epg.description: Jett delivers a special, hi-tech steering wheel to a girl, Nailah, in Cairo, Egypt. It's for her race quad, Pepper. They're in an off-road race that takes them all over the Sahara Desert.

epg.title: Little Bugs Big Trouble
epg.description: Jett delivers a bug shaped safari suit to a boy named Adrian in La Fortuna, Costa Rica! It's a big day as Adrian is going to lead his friends on a bug safari located on his parents zip line course.

epg.title: Lost Toys In Dreamland
epg.description: Jett and Jett Pet deliver a teddy bear to a girl named Rachel who lost her favourite teddy bear, Ute. With Astra and AP's help, they must then enter Rachel's dream, and find Ute in Dreamland Station.

epg.title: Broadcast Station Commotion
epg.description: Jett delivers a special child minder wrist link to Yeojun, a young Korean boy, so he can look after his younger brother Yeowoon as they follow their Dad to a big tv studio.

epg.title: Puppet Problems In Pilsen
epg.description: Jett and Jett Pet are called to the Czech Republic to deliver a marionette for a town's Historical Weekend Festival. Golden Boy steals the spotlight and gets caught in a giant Golem puppet.

epg.title: Alien Movie Stars
epg.description: Jett delivers special movie making equipment to a boy named Riley who wants to be a film director.

epg.title: Flying Clouds Of Colour

epg.title: My New Neighbor

epg.title: Runaway Piggy Bank

epg.title: The Rain Dragon

epg.title: Newfoundland Snow Wonderland
epg.description: Jett delivers a wool hat and gloves to a girl in Canada.

epg.title: Happy Birthday Fishes
epg.description: Jett and Jett Pet deliver special envelopes.

epg.title: Happy Mother's Day
epg.description: Jett attempts to deliver flowers for Mother's Day.

epg.title: There's A Shark In My Water Park
epg.original_title: There's A Shark In My Water Park
epg.description: Jett delivers a large wagon for an aquarium.

epg.title: Pasta Wars
epg.description: There is a space invasion under Jon Arbuckle's roof, and the aliens are looking very much like Garfield's favourite meal: lasagnas.

epg.title: A Game of Cat and Mouse
epg.original_title: A Game of Cat and Mouse
epg.description: Squeak and his mice family have taken up residence in Garfield's house, to Jon's despair, who will deprive Garfield of lasagnas if he doesn't turn things back to normal.

epg.title: Perfect Pizza
epg.description: Garfield's favourite restaurant, Vito's Pizzeria, is in jeopardy. The evil Mama Meany wants to buy it to expand his own restaurant, with the PizzaGrand 7000 capable of making ten pizzas a minute.

epg.title: Mother Garfield
epg.description: A mother bluebird is locked in a neighbourhood garage, so who will care for her eggs? That's a job for Garfield, who is sometimes quite a mother hen.

epg.title: Pup in the Pound
epg.description: Odie is found by Al the Dogcatcher with no license on his collar so he puts him in the city pound with other stray dogs. Garfield will do everything to get his friend back.

epg.title: Odie in Love
epg.description: Odie falls in love with a brush. Garfield becomes a little bit jealous about that and decides to make the brush disappear.

epg.title: Not So Sweet Sound of Music
epg.original_title: Not So Sweet Sound of Music
epg.description: Jon finds an old accordion. It's unbearable for Garfield who totally dislikes this music. He will do everything to get rid of it.

epg.title: Turkey Trouble
epg.description: Jon has won a live turkey in a raffle and wants to prepare it for dinner, but he can't make up his mind to eat it. Neither can Garfield!

epg.title: Catnap
epg.description: Garfield and Odie are watching a horror movie... They're scared. Jon, who has forgotten his key, is knocking at the door. The two pets won't let him in until he's proven his identity.

epg.title: Agent X
epg.description: Garfield is angry. A fake, secret agent is trying to steal the show and his popularity among his friends.

epg.title: Orange and Black
epg.description: It's Halloween! Garfield goes trick or treating and disguises himself as a scary Catzilla. But the real Catzilla has just escaped from the city zoo and will spread panic in Garfield's neighbourhood.

epg.title: Freaky Monday
epg.description: Odie has been thrown out of the house by Garfield and spends all night outside on his own. An alien crashes his UFO in the garden and loses a key part necessary to get back home!

epg.title: King Nermal
epg.description: Nermal's owner has gone away on vacation and Jon has offered to look after Nermal while he's gone. Watch out, everybody! The cutest kitten in the world he says so himself is coming over for a week!

epg.title: Desperately Seeking Pooky
epg.description: Who has stolen Pooky? After a night drying on the clothes line, Pooky has disappeared, and Garfield can't sleep without him.

epg.title: Curse of the Were-Dog
epg.description: It's night-time and the full moon and the alignment of the planets are having a strange effect on Odie.

epg.title: Meet the Parents
epg.description: Liz's parents are coming over to meet Jon and Jon really has to make a good impression.

epg.title: Down on the Farm
epg.description: Jon goes to visit his brother, Doc Boy, who lives on a livestock farm. It's out in the country, and since Garfield is a real city cat, it's no picnic for him!

epg.title: The Pet Show
epg.description: There is a Pet Show in town, and the winner will get a huge lasagna from Vito's restaurant. That's worth trying for Garfield. But Nermal is in the competition too...

epg.title: Pet Matchers
epg.description: There's a new TV Show called 'Instant Petmatching', which is about seeing if pets are matching with their owner. The result of the test is that Jon and Garfield are incompatible!

epg.title: Lucky Charm
epg.description: Odie finds the pot of gold at the bottom of a rainbow. The owner, a leprechaun, will grant all the wishes Garfield can think of.

epg.title: Bone Diggers
epg.description: Odie has found a strange, big bone in the garden. After some research, Garfield has found that it might be a dinosaur bone, and that could make him rich... enough for having lasagna forever, at least!

epg.title: The Robot
epg.description: A salesman has sold Jon a cleaning Robot, which is very annoying to his two pets.

epg.title: Itchy Lion Rescue
epg.description: When the Super Pets encounter an itchy lion at a sanctuary in South Africa, a girl named Carla wants a back scratcher to help scratch the lion's itches away.

epg.title: Busan Video Game Adventure
epg.description: The Super Pets go into a video game arcade and play a video game called Dessert Kingdom.

epg.title: Mighty Mammoth Sleigh
epg.description: When the Super Pets unearth a woolly mammoth from inside a cave, a Nenets boy named Kolya wants to keep it.

epg.title: Denmark Dinosaurs - Part 1
epg.description: A T-Rex skeleton on display in a Copenhagen museum becomes a living T-Rex thanks to a time warp ray operated by the Super Pets

epg.title: Denmark Dinosaurs - Part 2
epg.description: Jett, Dizzy,in robo-suits, a boy named Noah, a Robo-Rex and a T-Rex named Tyranno arrive in the Jurassic Period.

epg.title: Pet Hotel Panic
epg.description: The Super Pets spend a day at a Pet Hotel in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

epg.title: Chasing the Comet
epg.description: A young boy called Sisco and his Mamma uses his telescope to follow a pair of 'Mammababa' comets travelling across the galaxy together.

epg.title: Jett's Birthday Party
epg.description: It's Jett's birthday and almost all of his friends are throwing him a big birthday party!

epg.title: Racing For Riccardo
epg.description: When the truck transporting race cars gets lost, Jett, Jerome and Dizzy show up in Monza, Italy to take part in a very special Super Wings race against Golden Boy.

epg.title: Teeny Toy Takers
epg.description: While in Thailand, Super Pets Jett Pet and Paul Pet's fruit is swiped by a naughty monkey and they chase it into the yard of a boy, Thanawat, who's toys have also been going missing!

epg.title: How To Train Your Tarantula
epg.description: The Super Pets travel to Atocha Station in Madrid, Spain, where they help a boy, Mateo, and his Mom, secure a case for his 'scary' pet tarantula Estaban to ride the train.

epg.title: Go! Slow Jett
epg.description: Jett eats one of the Super Pets' trick chocolates, causing him to go slow, moving at a snail's pace.

epg.title: Blast From The Past
epg.description: When the Super Pets discover an erupting underwater volcano, a girl named Maima orders a megaphone to alert all the villagers fishing in the water.

epg.title: World Aircraft Tour Day
epg.description: The Super Pets are on World Aircraft to help Jett give some kids a tour. Jett is proud to show them the Control Room where Storm demonstrates how the package printer works!

epg.title: Paper Rangers Are Back
epg.description: The Super Pets travel to Tokyo, Japan to a film set, where they help the Paper Rangers repair a broken Origami Robot for a big action movie.

epg.title: Spin to Win Tornado
epg.description: The Super Pets get caught up in a tornado, managing to escape but crash landing in the garden of a boy called Fernando and his Papa, who are busy playing with Fernando's toys.

epg.title: Trash Monster Madness
epg.description: The Super Pets arrive in Brazil and stop at a water park. They meet a boy, Bruno, who has come to the park to swim, but they are all disappointed when they find trash all over the park!

epg.title: The Wild Little Mermaid
epg.description: When the Super Pets encounter a group of mermaid school students learning to befriend fish in Cebu, the Philippines, they meet a rowdy young girl named Lea who really wants to sing with them. The prob

epg.title: Time Travel Mayhem - Part 1
epg.description: The Super Pets are visiting Paris and they meet a young girl called Stella, accompanied by her Papa. She has travelled a long distance to fulfil her greatest wish, to go to the top of the Eiffel Tower

epg.title: Time Travel Mayhem - Part 2
epg.description: Storm and Stella search for Jett and Donnie after the two Superwings disappeared in thin air, ASTRA locating their whereabouts - they're in Paris, 1889!

epg.title: Flying Fish Frenzy
epg.description: While exploring Osaka, Japan, the Super Pets accidentally get stuck in a giant flying carp streamer and rip a boy named Hiroto's own koinobori!

epg.title: Giant Harvest Hero
epg.description: The Super Pets meet a boy named Taehoon and his giant robot on Jeju Island in South Korea. Before a typhoon comes, Taehoon tries to help his father with his robot to harvest all the tangerines!

epg.title: Machu Picchu Adventure
epg.description: When a little girl Veronica and her Dad accidentally fall in an Incan secret dark room, Jett, and Ellie show up in Machu Picchu, Peru, to take part in a historical rescue mission.

epg.title: The Fastest Snail In The World
epg.original_title: The Fastest Snail In The World
epg.description: When the Super Pets arrive at Ha Long, Vietnam, they meet boy named Hui and his pet snail, Peanut. Hui wants to take Peanut on a walk by Ha Long Bay, but Peanut is so slow.

epg.title: Down The Ant Tunnel
epg.description: The Super Pets travel to Verrenberg, a village in Hohenlohe, Germany where they participate in a water fight with Mona and her little brother Walter... Until they accidentally shoot Mona's necklace!

epg.title: Rock 'N' Roll Pinball
epg.description: When the Super Pets accidentally break a boulder resting on the roof of a mountaintop house in Monsanto, Portugal, a girl named Luisa orders colorful tape for Jett and Paul to stick it back together.

epg.title: Aerial Octo-Fuss
epg.description: The Super Pets' Mini Base accidentally get tangled up in a giant octopus kite, pulling it to the ground and destroying it.
